description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Lightning)] and [Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode I (Lightning)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, critical chance =25%/50%/75%/100% for Holy abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Holy Mode II (Lightning)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Holy Mode II (Lightning)
description.text: Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Holy abilities, grants [Quick Cast 3] to the user after using Holy abilities, grants [Buff Holy 30% (15s)] to the user/all allies if there are 0-3/4+ FF13 allies alive

description.name: Buff Holy 30% (15s)
description.text: Increases Holy damage dealt by 30%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Holy with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3
